author: Cleo Abram
description:
There’s a better way to predict the weather.

Here’s how your weather app works and what it might be able to do very soon…

But we know this year half the world’s weather system is about to break. To see why, subscribe.

#weather #extreme #tech #science #shorts #animation 

Note: Satellite imagery provided by NOAA/NESDIS. Forecast tracks and hurricane analysis shown were produced using Google DeepMind's experimental FNv3.1 model and do not constitute an official government weather forecast.
title: There’s A Better Way to Predict the Weather
